ideas.pitch: A training simulator built specifically to help teams practice for Round 1 of Triathlon by generating rapid-fire AI-written code snippets with hidden bugs and syntax traps.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Coding & CS Quiz focusing on predict the output, find the bug, and spotting hidden mistakes in AI-written code.
ideas.title: Triathlon AI Bug & Output Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the exact format of Round 1, helping competitors train under timed constraints to secure a higher starting budget for Round 2.

ideas.pitch: A rapid script that analyzes PCPartPicker component lists against strict bottleneck, power consumption, and compatibility rules to instantly resolve faults.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: PC Build Fix & Adapt where teams find and fix mistakes in a faulty PC parts list and rework builds mid-way through.
ideas.title: PCPartPicker Constraint Auto-Fixer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact bottleneck of Round 2 where speed and compliance with dynamic budget/use-case changes determine the hint points earned for Round 3.

ideas.pitch: An all-in-one local toolkit for rapid decryption of simple ciphers, hidden message extraction, and basic web/forensics artifact analysis.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 3: CTF Puzzle Hunt featuring a Jeopardy-style set of cybersecurity puzzles including hidden messages, simple ciphers, and web/forensics challenges.
ideas.title: CTF Cipher & Forensics Workbench
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gives competitors an unfair advantage during the high-pressure 50-minute CTF puzzle hunt by automating tedious cipher cracking and file metadata extraction.

ideas.pitch: A real-time dashboard for teams to calculate risk management, resource allocation of Round 1 budgets, and strategic conversion of Round 2 scores into Round 3 hint points.
ideas.problem_statement: About the Event: The rounds are linked where what a team earns in one round becomes a resource it spends in the next.
ideas.title: Triathlon Multi-Round Strategy Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on the unique linked-game mechanic of Triathlon, helping multi-member teams optimize their aggregate scores across all three stages.

ideas.pitch: A testing platform that injects subtle logic flaws and silent regressions into clean code to train developers on spotting AI hallucinations and bugs.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Coding & CS Quiz including spotting a hidden mistake in AI-written code.
ideas.title: Adversarial Code Mutation Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on hard engineering around code parsing and abstract syntax tree manipulation, ensuring a standout live demonstration for judges.
